I co-founded, built, and sold a SaaS that monitored companies' competitors on
Twitter and turned it into something they could act on. We had real paying
customers, names like Atlassian, Kind, and GetAround, plus PR and marketing
agencies, and I worked directly with customers, partners, and press to position
the product and the company. The hard-won lesson I still bring to clients: when
you build your business on top of another company's platform, a decision you
don't control can end it. I learned that the honest way, and I tell it straight
rather than dressing a shutdown up as an exit.
